description: An 8-step gate, trigger and CV sequencer with voltage control over sequence length and direction, one-shot modes, voltage addressing and a sample and hold on the CV outputs

params.text: Sets the voltage this step sends to OUT, from 0V at one end of its travel to the full range chosen by SCALE at the other
Sets how many steps the sequence runs for, from 1 to 8; a cable in the length CV input takes over from it
Chooses one of nine stepping modes: forward, pendulum, reverse, random, those same four as one-shots, and voltage addressed
In voltage addressed mode, picks the active step, full travel reaching the last step of the sequence; with a cable in the address CV input it attenuates that voltage instead
Sets the voltage range the step knobs cover, 1V to 8V in 1V increments
GATE samples a step's voltage as its gate goes high and holds it until another gated step arrives; OFF passes the step voltage on every step; TRIG samples at the start of each trigger pulse
Turns the trigger on for that step, so the TRIG output pulses there for as long as the clock pulse is high
Turns the gate on for that step, so the GATE output is high for the whole of it; switching it on for two steps in a row gives one unbroken gate

inputs.text: A high gate runs the sequencer and a low gate pauses it, picking up again at the next clock; with nothing patched the sequencer runs. 2V counts as high, 0.1V as low
A low-to-high edge moves the sequence on one step. 2V counts as high and 0.1V as low, and the time the clock spends high sets the length of the trigger output
A low-to-high edge restarts the sequence, which reaches step one on the next clock, or at once if the reset lands within 100uS of a clock edge. 2V counts as high
Sets the number of steps in the sequence from the applied voltage, 10V giving all 8, and disables the LENGTH switch for as long as a cable is connected
Sets the stepping mode from the applied voltage, one mode per volt: below 1V forward, then pendulum, reverse, random, the four one-shot modes, and voltage addressed from 8V up
In voltage addressed mode, selects the active step, 10V always reaching the last step whatever the sequence length; ADDR attenuates the voltage arriving here

outputs.text: Carries 10V for the whole of any step whose gate is switched on, staying high across consecutive gated steps
Carries 10V for as long as the clock pulse is high on any step whose trigger is switched on
In the one-shot modes, goes to 10V at the end of the last step and stays there until the sequence is restarted
Carries the voltage of the active step, multiplied by the range set by SCALE and held according to the S&H switch
Carries the voltage of the active step inverted, so a step set to 3V gives -3V here

notes: a green light beside a step number shows that step falls within the current sequence length, and a red light shows the step that is active
with the mouse pointer over the module, Shift+Ctrl+C randomizes the step knobs, Shift+Ctrl+G the gates, Shift+Ctrl+T the triggers and Shift+Ctrl+R all three
menu: Initialize — puts step settings back to their defaults, with a choice of CV only, Gates only, Triggers only or CV/Gates/Triggers only
Randomize — sets step settings at random, with a choice of CV only, Gates only, Triggers only or CV/Gates/Triggers only
Add channel expander — places an 8 Step Sequencer Channel Expander to the right of this module
Add gate expander — places an 8 Step Sequencer Gate Output Expander to the right of this module
Add trigger expander — places an 8 Step Sequencer Trigger Output Expander to the right of this module

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
